parts.text: You are provided with two solids: solid F and solid G. Do the following tests on solid F and solid G. Record all of your observations at each stage. Tests on solid F

ms.label: 2(a)(i)
ms.text:
effervescence / fizzing / bubbling
colourless solution / (some) solid dissolves / disappears
limewater become milky

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Filter the product from (a)(i) to obtain solution H as the filtrate. Carry out the tests on solid G while the mixture is filtering. Stop filtering after you have completed the tests on solid G. Divide solution H into three approximately equal portions in three test‑tubes.

ms.label: 2(b)(ii)
ms.text:
dropwise: white precipitate
excess: no further change / precipitate remains / white precipitate

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Put the remaining solid G in a boiling tube. Add about 5 cm depth of water to the boiling tube. Put a stopper in the boiling tube and shake the boiling tube to dissolve solid G and form solution G. Divide solution G into two approximately equal portions in two test‑tubes.

ms.label: 2(f)
ms.text:
M1 potassium / K
+
M2 bromide / Br
